# telnyx_tunnels (Data Source)

Lists tunnels, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_tunnel`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) The name of the tunnel.
- `filter_status` (String) The status of the tunnel. One of `degraded`, `healthy`, `inactive`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `-name`, `-status`, `-updated_at`, `created_at`, `name`, `status`, `updated_at`.

### Read-Only

- `tunnels` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnels))

<a id="nestedatt--tunnels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tunnels`

Read-Only:

- `connection_count` (Number) The number of tunnel processes connected with the tunnel's token.
- `connections` (Attributes List) The tunnel processes connected with the tunnel's token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnels--connections))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `name` (String) A user specified name for the tunnel.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) `inactive` when no tunnel process is connected, and `healthy` when one or more are. `degraded` (Preview, not reported yet) when a process is connected but fails to reach its destinations.

<a id="nestedatt--tunnels--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tunnels.connections`

Read-Only:

- `connected_at` (String) When the process connected.
- `hostname` (String) The name the host reports for itself. Preview: empty until the CLI reports it.
- `region_code` (String) The Telnyx region the process is connected to. Preview: empty until the CLI reports it.
- `version` (String) The `telnyx-edge` CLI version of the process. Preview: empty until the CLI reports it.
